s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic skin lesions with possible traumatic onset
salient_findings: Papules and pustules on the nose
key_facts: Prior trauma to nasal skin during farm work
Multiple papules and pustules on an erythematous base
Superficial ulceration and yellow crusting present
No improvement with systemic and topical antibiotics

raw.syndrome_frame: Chronic skin lesions with possible traumatic onset
salient_findings: Papules and pustules on the nose
key_facts: Prior trauma to nasal skin during farm work
Multiple papules and pustules on an erythematous base
Superficial ulceration and yellow crusting present
No improvement with systemic and topical antibiotics

shortlist.label: Lupus miliaris disseminatus faciei
shortlist.why_kept: matches chronic skin lesions with possible traumatic onset on the nose

shortlist.label: Rosacea
shortlist.why_kept: papules and pustules on the nose, consistent with rosacea presentation

shortlist.label: Folliculitis
shortlist.why_kept: superficial ulceration and yellow crusting, consistent with folliculitis

shortlist.label: Granuloma faciale
shortlist.why_kept: chronic skin lesions on the nose with erythematous base

shortlist.label: Discoid lupus erythematosus
shortlist.why_kept: skin lesions on the nose with possible discoid lupus erythematosus presentation

raw.rationale: The presence of multiple papules and pustules on an erythematous base with superficial ulceration and yellow crusting, particularly on the nose, along with a history of prior trauma and lack of response to antibiotics, aligns with the characteristics of Lupus miliaris disseminatus faciei.

rejected.label: Rosacea
rejected.why: While rosacea can present with papules and pustules, the specific combination of features such as superficial ulceration and the distribution on the nose, along with the history of trauma, makes it less likely than Lupus miliaris disseminatus faciei.

rejected.label: Folliculitis
rejected.why: Folliculitis typically involves the hair follicles and does not fully account for the range of symptoms, including the specific location and the presence of superficial ulceration and yellow crusting.

rejected.label: Granuloma faciale
rejected.why: Granuloma faciale is characterized by a single or a few large, brownish plaques, which does not match the multiple papules and pustules described in the case.

rejected.label: Discoid lupus erythematosus
rejected.why: Discoid lupus erythematosus typically presents with well-defined, discoid plaques that are scaly and can lead to scarring, which does not align with the acute presentation of papules and pustules in this case.
